problem.title: Verify Min Heap Property
problem.problemStatement: Given an array representation of a complete binary tree, determine whether it satisfies the Min Heap property.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains N space-separated integers.
problem.output: Print YES if the array represents a Min Heap; otherwise print NO.
